ACE MAGASHULE GOD FATHER OF THE FREE STATE

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Could Ace Magashule become our next president or will his alleged plotting

Unique Selling Point:
ACE Magashule is one of the most politically powerful people in the country, now he has been caught in an alleged plot and his back is against the wall. Will he survive or will Cyril Ramaphosa neutralise the man no one has been able to neutralise till now.

Summary:
ACE MAGASHULE: GODFATHER OF THE FREE STATE

"South Africans don't realize what danger we are in says Roy Jankielsohn, DA provincial leader in the Free state. He believes there is a possibility that Ace Magashule could be our next president. "I don't think Cyril is smart enough for Ace." And Ace, according to his former comrade Thabo Manyoni, whom Carte Blanche met last week, is extremely smart.

"There isn't a single contract in the Free State that Ace doesn't have his hands on, even down to the last cleaner," Manyoni told Carte Blanche. He should know he was Ace's deputy until 2016 when he resigned.

"I couldn't sleep at night, he said" it took courage to resign, and when I told Zuma, he just laughed. I let him laugh and then said "but you know Mr. President, I am going to fight you" now Manyoni is working against ACE and his plotters in KZN. He knows where all the bodies are buried but he won't testify at the Zondo commission. "I don't have a good memory for names and dates" he says. Others say it's because Manyoni was part of the state capture and has his own skeletons in the cupboard.

He also says: "even the cleaners know who they are beholden to for their jobs."



Further information:
Ace has served as ANC chairman under three different presidents, Mandela, Thabo Mbeki and Zuma and became free state premier when he was appointed by Zuma in 2009. Since then he has decimated municipalities in that province, as a quick look at the Auditor General's report shows.

In Maluti- a- Phafung he brought in a gangster mayor that he knew would be pliable. "That mayor came from Skotane" says Manyoni - he used to burn money- "this is the quality of people the ANC installed as mayors," he says sarcastically. The rest is history as municipalities across the free state teeter on the edge of bankrupcy.

"Ace wrote the book on state capture, Zuma only read the first chapter" according to Jankielsohn. He says that David Mabuza has too much baggage, he betrayed the premier league when he threw his hat in with Cyril and he will pay for that. "No one will support him, but Ace is a different story." If the plotters can get rid of Cyril by getting enough of their cronies in, Ace could be our next president.And if that happens, he says "Zuma's state capture project will be a picnic"

That much is clear, Ace Magashule's scandals start in the 1990's when he was fired by Mosiuoa Lekota. Lekota, Magashule's predecessor as premier, fired him as a MEC when corruption charges were levelled against the now ANC secretary-general. In court papers, it was alleged that Magashule and other senior ANC members attempted to solicit a share of a development from Ya Rona Investments in exchange for approval of the sale of land belonging to the Mangaung municipality
The 2010 Soccer World Cup contract
Magashule was allegedly pulling the strings behind a multimillion-rand tender to provide soccer-related regalia during the World Cup in 2010. AmaBhungane reported the R9.5-million tender was to supply 30,000 t-shirts and 20 000 blankets.
The businessman at the centre of the deal this year claimed that his company was used as a front for an entity allegedly close to Magashule. The police inquiry into Magashule's alleged role in the matter was reportedly buried without proper investigation.
Magashule and TAD Consultancy.
AmaBhungane reported that the Free State department of police, roads and transport had allegedly bypassed the State Information Technology Agency (Sita), which is responsible for managing large information and communication technology (ICT) tenders for government.
The Free State issued and awarded what it calls the "One Stop ICT Fusion Centre" tender without Sita approval. The contract was awarded in June 2016 to TAD Consultancy and Services, a company headed by Deena Pillay, who was Magashule's secretary while he was provincial sports minister in the mid-90s. AmaBhungane found Pillay and his family managed to secure dozens of state contracts in the Free State since Magashule became premier in 2009.
Since then he has been implicated in the R140 million rand website - the most expensive website in the history of South Africa - that report from the Public Protector is coming out next week. Then there are the Gupta links; the Vrede Dairy; his son's job with the Gupta's; his daughters links to a R150 million rand housing project in Bethlehem, which is the subject of criminal charges, and recently the revelations in the Zondo commission that the Free state paid the lion's share of million to the NEW age.
But nothing sticks says Jankielsohn, who says Ace uses other people's phones and never puts his signature on anything. Now Ace has been promoted to the most powerful position in the ANC as Secretary General.
But the Secretary General now has his back against the wall after the revelations that he was plotting to oust the President emerged in the Sunday times two weeks ago. Few believe his denials. And this quote from Ace has become the laughing stock of the country:
"I met with Zuma, but I did not intend on meeting with Zuma as a meeting is not necessarily a meeting to meet individuals but rather a meeting intended to meet with him in a capacity that we had already met'

On Monday minister Blade Nzimande came out guns blazing against Magashule at the Cosatu conference. So too has ANC chief Whip Jackson Mthembu who has called for an investigation into the alleged Maharani plot. Will Ace survive? "He was elected "says Pieter Louis Myburgh and it won't be that simple just to get rid of him. Jankielsohn agrees: " The only way Cyril is going to get rid of him is if there is a cut and dried criminal case against him" and that isn't so easy, because as everyone acknowledges: ACE IS SMART!

We will work on interviews with ACE MAGASHULE, BLADE NZIMANDE, JACKSON MTHEMBU, PIETER LOUIS MYBURGH, AND DO AN INTERVIEW WITH ROY JANKIELSOHN- ALSO ELSABE ROCKMAN. WILL ALSO INCLUDE ZWELE MKHIZE MINISTER - DOING THAT THIS EVENING AT PRESS CLUB

FINAL SCRIPT ACE MAGASHULE TX Sunday 30th September 2018

Commentary One
22 years ago, Mosioa Lekota was premier of the Free State and dismissed one of his MEC's, Ace Magashule. Years later, Lekota has alleged that the dismissal, was in fact because he had caught Ace Magashule stealing public money. But the ANC didn't care, and in 2009, former President Zuma appointed Magashule as premier of the province

Up sound Nasrec December 2017

Eight years later, Magashule was elected as ANC secretary General, a powerful position that functions like a CEO

Mcebisi Ndletyana
The very fact that he made it as Secretary General was a shock

Commentary Two
Professor Mcebisi Ndletyana is associate professor of politics at the University of Johannesburg

Mcebisi Ndletyana
This fellow had been in the Free State as chairperson for almost 20 years, he was more like a party baron of sorts, so to have someone like that who has such a massive ego, prone to dictatorial tendencies, prone to malfeasance, manipulating organizational processes to suit himself, to have someone like that as the Secretary General of the ANC spelt bad news, because it meant he would take whatever he was doing in the Free State into the National office

Devi link
Years ago Ace Magashule promised these people better housing, today let's take a look at what they have, a bank of taps… actually just one tap, and let's look at the bathrooms - it's actually shocking! Six long drops. No doors

Commentary Three
People living in these shacks were supposed to be moved to this housing project called Vogelfontein on the outskirts of Bethlehem, but some-how they were forgotten

Devi
You telling me ACE Magashule has been here?
David Mokoena
Yes
Devi
And what promises did he make?
David Mokoena
That he would give my mother a house


Commentary Four
But that never happened. And any way Vogelfontein's houses have just been cobbled together.

Author of the Republic of Gupta, Pieter louis Myburgh has investigated this housing project. He reported that it was Ace Magashule's daughter company that was awarded the tender to build them.

Pieter-louis Myburgh
That is a clear-cut example of Magashule using his power to channel money and contracts to his own family

Commentary Five
Vogelfontein cost R150 million rand. Opposition councillor Eric Motloung introduced us to resident Dopsie Ndweni

Eric
This is what R150 million rand looks like

Commentary Six
No ceilings, no electricity, bring your own door, oh and only every second person gets water inside. This is where Dobsie is supposed to wash her dishes

Devi
This is supposed to be the bathroom. So in the middle of the night if you need to go the toilet what do you do?
Dopsie
At night when we relieve ourselves we use a bucket. We have to wait until morning to take it outside.

Commentary seven
And looks are deceptive- the solar geysers on the rooftops don't work either.
Eric
They geysers are just there for decoration I think
Devi
Decoration
Eric
Yes, they are not working

Pieter- Louis Myburgh
I think if the Hawks and the NPA and the SSA had operated functionally, Magashule without a doubt in my mind would have been behind bars many years ago

Commentary eight
But Magashule protests his innocence and has defended his support of the Gupta's, even as the Hawks investigate the Estina dairy scandal. R30 million rand meant for poor free state farmers was used to fund the lavish Gupta Sun City wedding

Ace
Wherever there is corruption the law must take its place whether it's with Vrede Dairy or any other thing

Commentary nine
But if he has a case to answer, Ace Magashule has never been asked to account. Meanwhile towns across the Free state are decaying, and a third of the population survive on social grants

Pieter-Louis
It is a broken province, the Auditor General's report tells a very scary story of municipalities that have either collapsed already, or are on the brink of collapse

Commentary ten
Between 2013 and 2017 nearly a billion rand was lost through wasteful expenditure by Free state municipalities.

Roy Jankielson
Ace Magashule wrote the book on state capture, and Jacob Zuma only read chapter one of that book

Commentary Eleven
Dr. Roy Jankielsohn is the leader of the opposition in the Free State legislature, and has clashed many times with Magashule

Roy Jankielsohn
I think Ace Magashule epitomizes a war lord figure. All the tenders are controlled by him and if you look at it its very dangerous to oppose Ace Magashule especially if you are in the ANC, and we find even some of our colleagues in the legislature live in constant fear, not only for their positions but even for their lives

Link
The allegations that we sent to Magashule, paint a picture of a corrupt man who began here in his hometown of Parys and ended up running the Free state like his own personal fiefdom.

Commentary twelve
Magashule never answered our allegations. When we asked for a list of his achievements we were sent this list. The province has funded 10 000 bursaries

We also sent allegations to new Premier Sisi Ntombela. Her office replied that they don't warrant a dignified response.

Pieter Louis
if you look at the Free State province it is being led by Sisi Ntombela who very much came from the Magashule camp and that is where there should be some concern from a public interest perspective, you know trying to protect the public purse.

Commentary Thirteen
Magashule, meanwhile has had his own problems, ever since his clandestine meeting with the former president and Premier of the North West was exposed earlier this month. Were they plotting to unseat President Ramaphosa? No, they said. It was a meeting to discuss organizational issues.

LINK
Ace Magashule response to the allegations of a plot left many observers unconvinced and South Africans are still trying to figure out what he meant when he said the following:
"I met with Zuma but I did not intend on meeting with Zuma as a meeting is not necessarily a meeting to meet individuals but rather a meeting intended to meet with him in a capacity that we had already met" Huh?

Commentary fourteen
And the president wasn't buying it either. At Cosatu's congress he had strong words for people who plot in corners.

President Cyril Ramaphosa
We should not spend time on counter revolutionary machinations weakening this ANC, where either in dark corners or wherever we come up with machinations of weakening the ANC.

Commentary fifteen
A few days later in Bloemfontein, Magashule hit back, clearly making reference to President Ramaphosa

Devi
And he said: "I am not a product of white people, I am not a product of capital, there are people who are products of the white man in the ANC. He is upping the ante?

Mcebisi Ndletyana
I guess what this says is that ACE is not about to be intimidated. He is telling them bring it on I am ready for you
Devi
He also then said there is no ANC leadership which I am part of that is going to stop me and many others from meeting President Jacob Zuma. He still refers to Jacob Zuma as the president?
Mcebisi Ndletyana he laughs
Well it could be the slip of a tongue but what we are certain about is that he doesn't respect Cyril Ramaphosa, that is very clear!

Dr. Roy Jankielsohn
I have no doubt that Ace Magashule will become president, he is undermining Cyril Ramaphosa. He is going to allow David Mabuza to fall and the next person in line will be Ace Magashule

Pieter- Louis
I wouldn't exaggerate his power, I think what we have seen at the moment is of a man who is in a corner, but the tectonic plates in the ANC move quickly and it's difficult to keep up. But Ace is a man who is patient and able to plot strategically, and shift the political power balance back in his favour

Devi
Could Ace be our next president?
Mcebisi Ndletyana
Unlikely, I don't think the ANC want to go through that route again, they have suffered a lot they don't want a reincarnation of a JZ presidency

Commentary sixteen
Pressure on Ace Magashule is mounting. Recently at the Zondo commission, treasury revealed that the Free State had paid Gupta media companies almost R80 million rand. Ace Magashule says he will go to the commission and sing beyond the terms of reference. Perhaps he can also explain why the Free state paid R140 million rand for their provincial website

Peter Louis Myburgh
And it may be a world record in terms of paying for a website

Commentary seventeen
The DA are waiting for the Public protector's findings on the website. They have also sent a dossier of 17 other concerns to the Zondo commission, that they want investigated

Mcebisi Ndletyana
My prediction was that by June he would be gone, and I was assuming that the SIU and the Hawks would have done their jobs.

Commentary eighteen
But the Hawks are slow and Magashule is patient

Pieter- Louis
It's now clear that the authorities on the ground, the hawks and Saps, have willfully ignored corruption and that is why he has been able to get away with some of the schemes that he has been linked with

Commentary nineteen
But even if Ramaphosa wants to get rid of Ace Magashule, he can't
Pieter-Louis
People are calling for Magashule's head because of this plotting against Ramaphosa, but it's very difficult to go out and chop off him from the ANC at this moment. You have to remember that Magashule was elected by the ANC own internal democratic process at the ANC conference in 2017

Commentary twenty
So for now the battle for the soul of the ANC continues

Mcebisi Mdletyana
The next three months are going to be very tough for the ANC because it's going to go through its parliamentary list process, and it's going to be very tough for Cyril as well because he cannot include compromised people in his list because he is promising the public a clean ANC! A corruption free ANC so he has to act, he has to bite the bullet there is no other way around it!

Commentary Twenty-one
But even if Ramaphosa acts, little will change here in Vogelfontein, where grannies like Dopsie will still have to use buckets for toilets in the middle of the night

THE END 11 11

PROMO ONE 10 sec
Ace Magashule is one of the most powerful men in the country. What are his political ambitions? And what legacy did he leave behind as the former premier of the free state

PROMO TWO 15 sec
Recently Ace Magashule, the new secretary general of the ANC clashed with President Ramaphosa

Roy Jankielson
Ace Magashule wrote the book on state capture, and Jacob Zuma only read chapter one of that book

PROMO THREE
Secretary General of the ANC, Ace Magashule says he will testify at the Zondo commission

Pieter Louis Myburgh
I think if the Hawks and the NPA and the SSA had operated functionally, Magashule without a doubt in my mind would have been behind bars many years ago

PROMO FOUR 30 seconds
Devi
He also then said there is no ANC leadership which I am part of that is going to stop me and many others from meeting President Jacob Zuma. He still refers to Jacob Zuma as the president?
Mcebisi Ndletyana he laughs
what we are certain about is that he doesn't respect Cyril Ramaphosa!

Dr. Roy Jankielsohn
I have no doubt that Ace Magashule will become president, he is undermining Cyril Ramaphosa. David Mabuza will fall and the next person in line will be Ace Magashule

But the ANC didn't care, and in 2009, former President Zuma appointed Magashule as premier of the province Up sound Nasrec December 2017 Eight years later, Magashule was elected as ANC secretary General, a powerful position that functions like a CEO Mcebisi Ndletyana The very fact that he made it as Secretary General was a shock Commentary Two Professor Mcebisi Ndletyana is associate professor of politics at the University of Johannesburg Mcebisi Ndletyana This fellow had been in the Free State as chairperson for almost 20 years, he was more like a party baron of sorts, so to have someone like that who has such a massive ego, prone to dictatorial tendencies, prone to malfeasance, manipulating organizational processes to suit himself, to have someone like that as the Secretary General of the ANC spelt bad news, because it meant he would take whatever he was doing in the Free State into the National office Devi link Years ago Ace Magashule promised these people better housing, today let's take a look at what they have, a bank of taps… actually just one tap, and let's look at the bathrooms - it's actually shocking! Six long drops. No doors Commentary Three People living in these shacks were supposed to be moved to this housing project called Vogelfontein on the outskirts of Bethlehem, but some-how they were forgotten Devi You telling me ACE Magashule has been here? David Mokoena Yes Devi And what promises did he make? David Mokoena That he would give my mother a house Commentary Four But that never happened. And any way Vogelfontein's houses have just been cobbled together. Author of the Republic of Gupta, Pieter louis Myburgh has investigated this housing project. He reported that it was Ace Magashule's daughter company that was awarded the tender to build them. Pieter-louis Myburgh That is a clear-cut example of Magashule using his power to channel money and contracts to his own family Commentary Five Vogelfontein cost R150 million rand. Opposition councillor Eric Motloung introduced us to resident Dopsie Ndweni Eric This is what R150 million rand looks like Commentary Six No ceilings, no electricity, bring your own door, oh and only every second person gets water inside. This is where Dobsie is supposed to wash her dishes Devi This is supposed to be the bathroom. So in the middle of the night if you need to go the toilet what do you do? Dopsie At night when we relieve ourselves we use a bucket. We have to wait until morning to take it outside. Commentary seven And looks are deceptive- the solar geysers on the rooftops don't work either. Eric They geysers are just there for decoration I think Devi Decoration Eric Yes, they are not working Pieter- Louis Myburgh I think if the Hawks and the NPA and the SSA had operated functionally, Magashule without a doubt in my mind would have been behind bars many years ago Commentary eight But Magashule protests his innocence and has defended his support of the Gupta's, even as the Hawks investigate the Estina dairy scandal. R30 million rand meant for poor free state farmers was used to fund the lavish Gupta Sun City wedding Ace Wherever there is corruption the law must take its place whether it's with Vrede Dairy or any other thing Commentary nine But if he has a case to answer, Ace Magashule has never been asked to account. Meanwhile towns across the Free state are decaying, and a third of the population survive on social grants Pieter-Louis It is a broken province, the Auditor General's report tells a very scary story of municipalities that have either collapsed already, or are on the brink of collapse Commentary ten Between 2013 and 2017 nearly a billion rand was lost through wasteful expenditure by Free state municipalities. Roy Jankielson Ace Magashule wrote the book on state capture, and Jacob Zuma only read chapter one of that book Commentary Eleven Dr. Roy Jankielsohn is the leader of the opposition in the Free State legislature, and has clashed many times with Magashule Roy Jankielsohn I think Ace Magashule epitomizes a war lord figure. All the tenders are controlled by him and if you look at it its very dangerous to oppose Ace Magashule especially if you are in the ANC, and we find even some of our colleagues in the legislature live in constant fear, not only for their positions but even for their lives Link The allegations that we sent to Magashule, paint a picture of a corrupt man who began here in his hometown of Parys and ended up running the Free state like his own personal fiefdom. Commentary twelve Magashule never answered our allegations. When we asked for a list of his achievements we were sent this list. The province has funded 10 000 bursaries We also sent allegations to new Premier Sisi Ntombela. Her office replied that they don't warrant a dignified response. Pieter Louis if you look at the Free State province it is being led by Sisi Ntombela who very much came from the Magashule camp and that is where there should be some concern from a public interest perspective, you know trying to protect the public purse. Commentary Thirteen Magashule, meanwhile has had his own problems, ever since his clandestine meeting with the former president and Premier of the North West was exposed earlier this month. Were they plotting to unseat President Ramaphosa? No, they said. It was a meeting to discuss organizational issues. LINK Ace Magashule response to the allegations of a plot left many observers unconvinced and South Africans are still trying to figure out what he meant when he said the following: "I met with Zuma but I did not intend on meeting with Zuma as a meeting is not necessarily a meeting to meet individuals but rather a meeting intended to meet with him in a capacity that we had already met" Huh? Commentary fourteen And the president wasn't buying it either. At Cosatu's congress he had strong words for people who plot in corners. President Cyril Ramaphosa We should not spend time on counter revolutionary machinations weakening this ANC, where either in dark corners or wherever we come up with machinations of weakening the ANC. Commentary fifteen A few days later in Bloemfontein, Magashule hit back, clearly making reference to President Ramaphosa Devi And he said: "I am not a product of white people, I am not a product of capital, there are people who are products of the white man in the ANC. He is upping the ante? Mcebisi Ndletyana I guess what this says is that ACE is not about to be intimidated. He is telling them bring it on I am ready for you Devi He also then said there is no ANC leadership which I am part of that is going to stop me and many others from meeting President Jacob Zuma. He still refers to Jacob Zuma as the president? Mcebisi Ndletyana he laughs Well it could be the slip of a tongue but what we are certain about is that he doesn't respect Cyril Ramaphosa, that is very clear! Dr. Roy Jankielsohn I have no doubt that Ace Magashule will become president, he is undermining Cyril Ramaphosa. He is going to allow David Mabuza to fall and the next person in line will be Ace Magashule Pieter- Louis I wouldn't exaggerate his power, I think what we have seen at the moment is of a man who is in a corner, but the tectonic plates in the ANC move quickly and it's difficult to keep up. But Ace is a man who is patient and able to plot strategically, and shift the political power balance back in his favour Devi Could Ace be our next president? Mcebisi Ndletyana Unlikely, I don't think the ANC want to go through that route again, they have suffered a lot they don't want a reincarnation of a JZ presidency Commentary sixteen Pressure on Ace Magashule is mounting. Recently at the Zondo commission, treasury revealed that the Free State had paid Gupta media companies almost R80 million rand. Ace Magashule says he will go to the commission and sing beyond the terms of reference. Perhaps he can also explain why the Free state paid R140 million rand for their provincial website Peter Louis Myburgh And it may be a world record in terms of paying for a website Commentary seventeen The DA are waiting for the Public protector's findings on the website. They have also sent a dossier of 17 other concerns to the Zondo commission, that they want investigated Mcebisi Ndletyana My prediction was that by June he would be gone, and I was assuming that the SIU and the Hawks would have done their jobs. Commentary eighteen But the Hawks are slow and Magashule is patient Pieter- Louis It's now clear that the authorities on the ground, the hawks and Saps, have willfully ignored corruption and that is why he has been able to get away with some of the schemes that he has been linked with Commentary nineteen But even if Ramaphosa wants to get rid of Ace Magashule, he can't Pieter-Louis People are calling for Magashule's head because of this plotting against Ramaphosa, but it's very difficult to go out and chop off him from the ANC at this moment. You have to remember that Magashule was elected by the ANC own internal democratic process at the ANC conference in 2017 Commentary twenty So for now the battle for the soul of the ANC continues Mcebisi Mdletyana The next three months are going to be very tough for the ANC because it's going to go through its parliamentary list process, and it's going to be very tough for Cyril as well because he cannot include compromised people in his list because he is promising the public a clean ANC! A corruption free ANC so he has to act, he has to bite the bullet there is no other way around it! Commentary Twenty-one But even if Ramaphosa acts, little will change here in Vogelfontein, where grannies like Dopsie will still have to use buckets for toilets in the middle of the night THE END 11 11 PROMO ONE 10 sec Ace Magashule is one of the most powerful men in the country. What are his political ambitions? And what legacy did he leave behind as the former premier of the free state PROMO TWO 15 sec Recently Ace Magashule, the new secretary general of the ANC clashed with President Ramaphosa Roy Jankielson Ace Magashule wrote the book on state capture, and Jacob Zuma only read chapter one of that book PROMO THREE Secretary General of the ANC, Ace Magashule says he will testify at the Zondo commission Pieter Louis Myburgh I think if the Hawks and the NPA and the SSA had operated functionally, Magashule without a doubt in my mind would have been behind bars many years ago PROMO FOUR 30 seconds Devi He also then said there is no ANC leadership which I am part of that is going to stop me and many others from meeting President Jacob Zuma. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Could Ace Magashule become our next president or will his alleged plotting
metadata.Unique Selling Point: ACE Magashule is one of the most politically powerful people in the country, now he has been caught in an alleged plot and his back is against the wall. Will he survive or will Cyril Ramaphosa neutralise the man no one has been able to neutralise till now.
metadata.Summary: ACE MAGASHULE: GODFATHER OF THE FREE STATE "South Africans don't realize what danger we are in says Roy Jankielsohn, DA provincial leader in the Free state. He believes there is a possibility that Ace Magashule could be our next president. "I don't think Cyril is smart enough for Ace." And Ace, according to his former comrade Thabo Manyoni, whom Carte Blanche met last week, is extremely smart. "There isn't a single contract in the Free State that Ace doesn't have his hands on, even down to the last cleaner," Manyoni told Carte Blanche. He should know he was Ace's deputy until 2016 when he resigned. "I couldn't sleep at night, he said" it took courage to resign, and when I told Zuma, he just laughed. I let him laugh and then said "but you know Mr. President, I am going to fight you" now Manyoni is working against ACE and his plotters in KZN. He knows where all the bodies are buried but he won't testify at the Zondo commission. "I don't have a good memory for names and dates" he says. Others say it's because Manyoni was part of the state capture and has his own skeletons in the cupboard. He also says: "even the cleaners know who they are beholden to for their jobs."
metadata.Further information: Ace has served as ANC chairman under three different presidents, Mandela, Thabo Mbeki and Zuma and became free state premier when he was appointed by Zuma in 2009. Since then he has decimated municipalities in that province, as a quick look at the Auditor General's report shows. In Maluti- a- Phafung he brought in a gangster mayor that he knew would be pliable. "That mayor came from Skotane" says Manyoni - he used to burn money- "this is the quality of people the ANC installed as mayors," he says sarcastically. The rest is history as municipalities across the free state teeter on the edge of bankrupcy. "Ace wrote the book on state capture, Zuma only read the first chapter" according to Jankielsohn. He says that David Mabuza has too much baggage, he betrayed the premier league when he threw his hat in with Cyril and he will pay for that. "No one will support him, but Ace is a different story." If the plotters can get rid of Cyril by getting enough of their cronies in, Ace could be our next president.And if that happens, he says "Zuma's state capture project will be a picnic" That much is clear, Ace Magashule's scandals start in the 1990's when he was fired by Mosiuoa Lekota. Lekota, Magashule's predecessor as premier, fired him as a MEC when corruption charges were levelled against the now ANC secretary-general. In court papers, it was alleged that Magashule and other senior ANC members attempted to solicit a share of a development from Ya Rona Investments in exchange for approval of the sale of land belonging to the Mangaung municipality The 2010 Soccer World Cup contract Magashule was allegedly pulling the strings behind a multimillion-rand tender to provide soccer-related regalia during the World Cup in 2010. AmaBhungane reported the R9.5-million tender was to supply 30,000 t-shirts and 20 000 blankets. The businessman at the centre of the deal this year claimed that his company was used as a front for an entity allegedly close to Magashule. The police inquiry into Magashule's alleged role in the matter was reportedly buried without proper investigation. Magashule and TAD Consultancy. AmaBhungane reported that the Free State department of police, roads and transport had allegedly bypassed the State Information Technology Agency (Sita), which is responsible for managing large information and communication technology (ICT) tenders for government. The Free State issued and awarded what it calls the "One Stop ICT Fusion Centre" tender without Sita approval. The contract was awarded in June 2016 to TAD Consultancy and Services, a company headed by Deena Pillay, who was Magashule's secretary while he was provincial sports minister in the mid-90s. AmaBhungane found Pillay and his family managed to secure dozens of state contracts in the Free State since Magashule became premier in 2009. Since then he has been implicated in the R140 million rand website - the most expensive website in the history of South Africa - that report from the Public Protector is coming out next week. Then there are the Gupta links; the Vrede Dairy; his son's job with the Gupta's; his daughters links to a R150 million rand housing project in Bethlehem, which is the subject of criminal charges, and recently the revelations in the Zondo commission that the Free state paid the lion's share of million to the NEW age. But nothing sticks says Jankielsohn, who says Ace uses other people's phones and never puts his signature on anything. Now Ace has been promoted to the most powerful position in the ANC as Secretary General. But the Secretary General now has his back against the wall after the revelations that he was plotting to oust the President emerged in the Sunday times two weeks ago. Few believe his denials. And this quote from Ace has become the laughing stock of the country: "I met with Zuma, but I did not intend on meeting with Zuma as a meeting is not necessarily a meeting to meet individuals but rather a meeting intended to meet with him in a capacity that we had already met' On Monday minister Blade Nzimande came out guns blazing against Magashule at the Cosatu conference. So too has ANC chief Whip Jackson Mthembu who has called for an investigation into the alleged Maharani plot. Will Ace survive? "He was elected "says Pieter Louis Myburgh and it won't be that simple just to get rid of him. Jankielsohn agrees: " The only way Cyril is going to get rid of him is if there is a cut and dried criminal case against him" and that isn't so easy, because as everyone acknowledges: ACE IS SMART! We will work on interviews with ACE MAGASHULE, BLADE NZIMANDE, JACKSON MTHEMBU, PIETER LOUIS MYBURGH, AND DO AN INTERVIEW WITH ROY JANKIELSOHN- ALSO ELSABE ROCKMAN. WILL ALSO INCLUDE ZWELE MKHIZE MINISTER - DOING THAT THIS EVENING AT PRESS CLUB
